==Dialogue==
:''"My husband, [[Merkhet]], survived the debacle at [[Consulate Docks|Gandara]], but has not yet found his way home. He paid a [[corsair]] to send me word that he was trying to book passage from the [[Barbarous Shore|Barbarous Coast]]. But, I haven't heard anything since, so I'm afraid he may have been captured or killed."''
